title: Tengen: Atari Games vs. Nintendo
summary: Gaming Historian recounts how Atari subsidiary Tengen challenged Nintendo's licensing rules with a lawsuit and unlicensed NES games, including the lockout chip fight.
why: Recommended as a compact account of the Atari-Nintendo lawsuit and its technical and legal details, which shaped the game industry.

quote.text: Highly recommended to learn about the technical and legal details of the lawsuit that shaped gaming industry landscape to this day.
